pages.text: The $(item)Resource Farm$() mines blocks: stone, ores, sand, nether blocks and so on. It needs a $(item)pickaxe, shovel or axe$() in the tool slot.$(br2)Its floor is stone.$(br2)$(thing)Ingredients$(): 6 glass panes (any), 1 pickaxe (any), 1 iron block.
Glass panes around a pickaxe, over an iron block.

Every full block that can be mined is covered, with drops read from vanilla loot tables, plus hand-made recipes for ores, logs, nether blocks and special cases. See $(l:easy_farms:resource_recipes/ores)Resource Farm Recipes$().
